note: Offline replay, no LLM calls. Honest user answers questions right and edits nothing else. Silent error = a setting at Create that differs from decide(measured, true facts).

policies.P0: never ask; every pick shown as sure
policies.P1: ask when readings disagree AND another answer changes a setting
policies.P2: P1 + ask every fact that matters when only opening pages were read (< 2 body pages)
policies.P3: P2 + always ask diagrams when it decides the locked Figures setting
policies.P4: ask only facts that decide a locked setting, when unsure; highlight other unsure facts that matter without asking
